name: Rediscovering the Light
label: Quest

intro: Offered by Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell, this task challenges newly raised Forsaken paladins to embrace the Holy Light once more. Calling upon holy powers inflicts intense agony upon undead flesh, requiring fledgling paladins to channel healing into injured Deathguards despite the burning torment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am proud to welcome another newly risen adventurer to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mastery of the light will return, in time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances.
Be well and walk in the light once more, adventurer.
